newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper and zinc climb, tin, nickel steady.
newsitem.headline: India copper and zinc climb, tin, nickel steady.

text.p: Copper, zinc and aluminium prices climbed up on the local metal market on Monday, dealers said.
Other base metals remained steady in limited activity.

"Demand from local industrial consumers remained sluggish today but base metals extended gains on expectations that state-owned producers may hike selling prices for next month," said Sharat Parikh, president of the Bombay Metals Exchange.
Copper moved up by 25 rupees to 13,625 rupees per quintal while zinc rose by 50 rupees to 8,000 rupees per quintal. Aluminium moved up by 50 rupees at 7,650 rupees per quintal.
"Hindustan Copper Ltd. may hike selling prices by 5,000 rupees per tonne and Hindustan Zinc may hike prices by 1,000 rupees per tonne for June," Parikh added.

Tin was steady at 31,400 rupees per quintal after gaining 200 rupees last week while nickel was steady at 37,200 rupees after gaining 400 rupees per quintal last week. Lead was quiet at 4,150 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
